name: peek-popout-springs-into-its-tab
description: The pop-out button grows the peek card out to the pane with a spring, and the page lands as a real tab once it settles. Same fixture, gate and link coordinates as peek-controls-close-the-card.json, and the same .pkc-popout click path (chrome.send('peekControl', ['popout']) into BrowserController::PromotePeek). Also records the page behind the card at 0.96 while the peek is open (AtriumBrowserWindow::SetPeekScrimVisible), and back at full size after. The popout capture starts right after the click with no settle, so the frames span as much of the grow as the SSH round trip allows; the proof of the promote itself is the sidebar tab row count and the vlog line PeekWidget::Close prints once the spring lands.
